entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture for alpha-cutout foliage cards in a grounded painterly 3D game. Create ONE isolated Texas live-oak leafy twig cluster, actual transparent RGBA background. Orthographic front view, entirely flat painted albedo, no perspective, no floor, no cast shadow, no ambient backdrop, no labels. Composition a broad irregular horizontal oval cluster centered, filling 85% of square canvas with transparent perimeter and many small transparent sky holes between leaves. About 35 small oval evergreen leaves along five branching slender twigs. Leaves form overlapping groups with a coherent irregular brush-shaped silhouette, not a solid green cloud. Hand-painted gouache / impressionistic oil-like brush marks with simple distinct broad warm sage and spring green leaf planes, muted blue-green darker undersides and a few yellow-green highlights. Moderate tonal variation, no black outlines, no stark white speculars, no photoreal microtexture. Branches tiny warm brown, mostly obscured. All leaves remain connected into one believable branchlet, feathered asymmetric outside edges. Detail readable when mapped onto a 0.6 meter foliage cluster. Original artwork, no imitation of any game's asset. Output a square texture around 1024 pixels with genuine transparency.
